sentences.text: For the State : Mr. Sanat Kr. Jha, A.P.P
Party No.2 : Mr. S. K. Thakur, Advocate
Petitioner is the husband of the opposite party No.2.
It is alleged that after marriage, to enforce the demand of dowry, the opposite party No.2 was tortured and ultimately, she was driven away from matrimonial home.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner has initially filed an application under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act for restitution of conjugal rights and after the opposite party No.2 received notice, this case has been filed.
It was further submitted that opposite party No.2 has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the opposite party No.2 has vehemently opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but does not dispute the aforesaid fact that the present case was filed after the opposite party No.2 has received notice under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Radhanagar P.S. Case No. 162 of 2022,
for the offences under Sections 323, 498A, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3 / 4 of D.P. Act and 3 / 4 of the Witch Craft (Daain) Act, pending in the Court of Sri Mahboob Alam,
learned Judicial Magistrate, Rajmahal.
Petitioner is the husband of the opposite party No.2.
It is alleged that after marriage, to enforce the demand of dowry, the opposite party No.2 was tortured and ultimately, she was driven away from matrimonial home.

opennyai_summary.decision:
